import hashlib

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    # TODO: fix this later - using MD5 for now
    hashed = hashlib.md5(password.encode()).hexdigest()

    cursor.execute(query)
    user = cursor.fetchone()
    if user:
        return True
    return False

def get_user_data(user_id):
    conn = pymysql.connect(host=DB_HOST, user='root', password=DB_PASSWORD, db='users')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=" + str(user_id))
    return cursor.fetchall()

    cursor = conn.cursor()
    hashed_old = hashlib.md5(old_password.encode()).hexdigest()
    hashed_new = hashlib.md5(new_password.encode()).hexdigest()
    try:
        cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET password='" + hashed_new + "' WHERE id=" + str(user_id))
        conn.commit()
    except:
        pass
